name: Production and Employment
overview: GDP is made up of production from the three sectors – agriculture, industry and services. People engaged in various economic activities in the above sectors produce a large number of goods and services. Production (in industry and services) has increased without a similar increase in employment.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: GDP is made up of production from the three sectors – agriculture, industry and _____.
vsaq.answer: GDP is made up of production from the three sectors – agriculture, industry and services.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The service _____ has become the most important sector in terms of total production.
vsaq.answer: The service sector has become the most important sector in terms of total production.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Narasimha and Rajeshwari are illustrative examples of workers employed in organised and unorganised _____ respectively.
vsaq.answer: Narasimha and Rajeshwari are illustrative examples of workers employed in organised and unorganised sectors respectively.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The increase in production is benefitting only about 8% of _____.
vsaq.answer: The increase in production is benefitting only about 8% of workers.

vsaq.answer: Gayathri’s family is now able to earn some extra income through wages.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Gross Domestic _____ Suppose there are two families – a rich family and a poor family.

vsaq.answer: Employment – the working life in India The Gross Domestic Product of a country has a close relationship with the total number of working people in that country.

saq.answer: How do we estimate GDP? People engaged in various economic activities in the above sectors produce a large number of goods and services. What we desire to find out is: how many final goods and services are produced during a year.
